title: [review] project-LICHEN-2auf.44.11.1.1: build broken — 26 compile errors from stale test call sites
description:
After renaming `load_existing` → `restore_existing` (with signature change to `(self, store)`), removing `protect_request` from `Context`, adding `include_piv: bool` to `protect_response`, and wrapping `sender_seq` in `Option<OscoreSeqNum>`, many test call sites were not updated. This causes 26 compilation errors across `lib.rs` test module and `vectors.rs`.

Affected call sites:
- `restore_existing` now takes `(self, store)` not `(secret, salt, id_context, sender_id, recipient_id, store)` — 6 call sites broken
- `protect_request` no longer exists on `Context` — 3 call sites broken  
- `protect_response` now requires `include_piv: bool` — 5+ call sites broken
- `sender_seq` is now `Option<OscoreSeqNum>` — 6+ sites calling `.increment()`, `.get()`, `.fetch_increment()`, `.encode_piv()` directly

Fix: update all test call sites to match new API signatures.
